description: Authored V5 EPI/family prose source. Generated objective and stage contracts must be rebuilt from this file plus the event-family and stage authority mappings.

uav_takeoff.required_response: the aircraft becomes airborne after occupying its home pad
uav_takeoff.unknown_policy: unknown if aircraft height or home-pad geometry is absent

uav_landing.required_response: touchdown occurs inside the aircraft landing zone
uav_landing.unknown_policy: unknown if aircraft height or landing-zone geometry is absent

restricted_region_intrusion.required_response: the aircraft is objectively detected crossing the governed restricted-airspace boundary margin
restricted_region_intrusion.unknown_policy: unknown if authoritative region geometry, activation, or boundary-margin evidence is absent

altitude_excursion.required_response: UAV climbs or descends toward the assigned altitude band
altitude_excursion.unknown_policy: unknown if assigned band is missing

uav_separation_conflict.required_response: both affected UAVs execute deconfliction or one yields by hold/divert
uav_separation_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown if either UAV trajectory is missing

uav_pedestrian_near_miss.required_response: UAV pulls up or clears the pedestrian exposure zone
uav_pedestrian_near_miss.unknown_policy: unknown if pedestrian pose or UAV altitude is missing

uav_vehicle_conflict.required_response: the bound ground vehicle brakes or enters emergency stop after the UAV-vehicle risk transition
uav_vehicle_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown when UAV pose, vehicle pose, pair distance, pair TTC, closing speed, or contact classification source is missing

vehicle_pedestrian_conflict.required_response: vehicle brakes and pedestrian retreats or clears the conflict zone
vehicle_pedestrian_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown if pedestrian or vehicle trajectory is incomplete

vehicle_intersection_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown if either vehicle trajectory is missing

corridor_congestion.required_response: hold, resequence, or divert reduces demand
corridor_congestion.unknown_policy: unknown if corridor capacity or membership cannot be enumerated

structure_near_miss.required_response: UAV performs evasion away from structure
structure_near_miss.unknown_policy: unknown if structure geometry is absent

forced_landing.required_response: safe landing zone is established, cleared, and used for touchdown
forced_landing.unknown_policy: unknown if descent driver or landing-zone validity is absent

c2_degradation_loss.unknown_policy: unknown if link metrics are absent and no governed simulation model is available

gnss_signal_degradation.required_response: relocalization, safe hold, or route correction starts after a real GNSS service degradation
gnss_signal_degradation.unknown_policy: unknown if true and reported pose cannot both be recovered

gnss_spoofing_effect.required_response: a typed spoofing signal and exact navigation-effect relation are available before claiming the spoofing event
gnss_spoofing_effect.unknown_policy: unknown if true and reported pose cannot both be recovered

charger_unavailable.required_response: route planner selects an alternate charger or rejects the task safely
charger_unavailable.unknown_policy: unknown if facility availability or reservation state is absent

pad_contention.required_response: arbitration grants priority and diverts non-priority UAVs
pad_contention.unknown_policy: unknown if requesters or pad capacity cannot be enumerated

signal_malfunction.required_response: vehicle queues form and police/manual control becomes active
signal_malfunction.unknown_policy: unknown if controller health or signal state is absent

road_closure.required_response: affected vehicles take detour and leave the closed segment
road_closure.unknown_policy: unknown if segment geometry or barrier state is absent

ambulance_priority.required_response: civilian vehicles yield and ambulance passes the conflict zone
ambulance_priority.unknown_policy: unknown if priority state or vehicle class is absent

av_safe_stop.required_response: AV reaches and holds a safe stopped position with warning active
av_safe_stop.unknown_policy: unknown if sensor fault or MRM state is absent

pedestrian_medical.required_response: detection, dispatch, arrival, handoff, and resolution are evidenced
pedestrian_medical.unknown_policy: unknown if posture or response state is absent

crowd_evacuation.required_response: crowd members move continuously from hazard zone to safe zone
crowd_evacuation.unknown_policy: unknown if crowd membership or zones are incomplete

temporary_airspace_lockdown.required_response: the controlled region isolates the hazardous area while affected UAVs reroute or hold outside it
temporary_airspace_lockdown.unknown_policy: unknown if hazardous-release measurements, lockdown state, or controlled-region geometry are absent

rain_fog_environment.required_response: only an environment event is emitted directly; UAV or traffic consequences require independent rules
rain_fog_environment.unknown_policy: unknown if weather parameters are absent

crosswind_payload_swing.required_response: attitude recovery reduces swing or mission terminates safely
crosswind_payload_swing.unknown_policy: unknown if wind vector or payload state is absent

high_temp_battery_derating.required_response: planner replans, aborts, returns home, or lands safely
high_temp_battery_derating.unknown_policy: unknown if battery or temperature is absent

jamming_gcs_intrusion.required_response: channel protection, safe hold, or control-station recovery starts from exact station evidence
jamming_gcs_intrusion.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent

unauthorized_command.required_response: typed command provenance is available and rejected before claiming an unauthorized-command event
unauthorized_command.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent

control_command_integrity_violation.required_response: a typed command stream and exact integrity failure are available before claiming the event
control_command_integrity_violation.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent

security_control_unavailability.required_response: a typed security control and exact unavailability relation are available before claiming the event
security_control_unavailability.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent
